My top best selling products on Etsy✨🩷 After 6 years of selling print on demand products through Printify + Etsy, these are some of the products that have consistently been best sellers for me: • Sweatshirts My favorites are the Gildan 18000 + Comfort Colors 1566. They’re super versatile, come in tons of colors, and there are now even more ways to customize them with DTG, DTF, embroidery AND some new printing options from Printify. Glitter puff print?!! More on that soon👀👀 • Phone Cases One of my favorite evergreen products because people are constantly switching out their cases. They’re also SO easy to design with patterns, photos, personalized designs and more. Plus, they’re especially great around new phone releases! • Glass Tumbler Cups These have been a bestseller for me ever since Printify released them! The prints come out so crisp and vibrant, they include a lid + straw, and they’re perfect for personalized gifts. And yes, even though they’re glass, I’ve sold a ton and have rarely had shipping issues! • Hardcover Journals Simple, easy to customize and such a good gift product. Patterns and personalized designs work especially well, and the print quality is SO good. I own way too many myself! • Embroidered Hats Especially the vintage + denim hats! I love the color options, the embroidery comes out super clean, and these have consistently sold really well in my shop. • Mugs A classic for a reason, but I like choosing mugs that stand out a little more while someone is scrolling. The accent color mugs + latte mugs are two of my favorites! The best part? These are all evergreen products, meaning they can sell year round, not just during one specific season! 📖 Watch me make & sell a children’s book on Etsy so you can do it too! 💗 Print on demand is one of my favorite online business models because you don’t have to buy inventory upfront, package orders yourself, or have boxes of products sitting around your house. You create the design, put it on products, list them in your shop, and when someone orders, your print-on-demand company makes and ships the product for you. 🙌 Some of the best products to test are: 👕 T-shirts ☕️ Mugs 👜 Tote bags 🧥 Sweatshirts & hoodies 📱 Phone cases 🖼️ Wall art & prints 🥤 Tumblers & water bottles ✨ Stickers 📓 Notebooks & journals 👶 Baby & kids apparel But here’s where a LOT of people get stuck… Creating enough good designs to actually fill a shop takes so much time. And the more products and niches you want to test, the more designs you need. That’s exactly why I love using done-for-you designs. Inside the ctrl-alt-design.com membership, you can get ready-made designs that you can put on your own print-on-demand products and sell. Instead of spending hours making every design yourself, you can focus that time on getting more high-quality listings up, testing more products and niches, and actually growing your shop. You add the designs to your products, sell them through your own shop, and keep the money you make from your sales after your normal platform and fulfillment costs. 💸 You don’t need to be a professional designer to start a print-on-demand business. You just need good products, good designs, and enough listings out there to figure out what your customers actually want.
